description: This file defines the TimeDate class within the WPEFramework::Broadcast namespace, which manages time synchronization via DVB tables (TDT and TOT). It includes nested classes for notification handling and section parsing, and provides methods for scanning, loading data, and handling tuner state changes.

classes.name: TimeDate
classes.description: Manages DVB time tables (TDT and TOT), handles tuner notifications, and provides scanning and data loading functionalities.

classes.name: Sink
classes.description: Implements ITuner::INotification to handle tuner activation, deactivation, and state changes, delegating to the parent TimeDate instance.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: Implements ISection to parse DVB sections related to TDT and TOT, and triggers loading of time data.

methods.name: TimeDate
methods.description: Constructor initializing the TimeDate object and registering tuner notifications.

methods.name: Scan
methods.description: Starts or stops scanning DVB tables based on the boolean parameter.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Handles tuner deactivation events, removing the tuner from internal tracking.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles tuner state changes, adding or removing scanners accordingly.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads time data from DVB TOT or TDT tables.
